finalText:
**`Redis` went down and took prod with it.**

| time | what happened |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08 | cache off, reads go straight to the store |
| 02:14:10 | store chokes, `TimeoutError` after 5000ms |
| 02:29:12 | queue depth passes the 500 cap |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` OOM, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `api` killed, service down |

13 reconnects fired, 80s apart, all refused. No request succeeded after `02:14:03` in [app.log](logs/app.log).

Next: find why `Redis` refused connections.
